content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: JSON and YAML can often represent equivalent mappings, sequences, and scalar values, but conversion can change types, omit comments, expose duplicate keys, or alter formatting. Compare parsed values and document what the target tools preserve.

content_blocks.title: What you will cover
content_blocks.text: This lesson explicitly addresses: JSON numbers and YAML numeric scalars. Boolean interpretation differences. Version-specific implicit typing.; Large integer interoperability. Quoting numeric-looking identifiers. Quoting values that resemble booleans.; Explicit conversion policies.. Treat each as part of a workflow: define what the data should mean, represent it consistently, and test how the chosen implementation interprets it.
